description: A skin eruption caused by an adverse reaction to a medicine.
symptoms: Other symptoms depend on the drug reaction

appearance.general: Drug eruptions can have many appearances, including widespread macules, papules, plaques, or other inflammatory patterns.

warning_signs: Facial swelling, difficulty breathing, blistering, skin pain, mouth or eye involvement, or extensive skin peeling requires urgent medical evaluation.
general_first_aid: Do not take additional doses of a suspected culprit medicine unless advised by the prescribing clinician; seek professional advice promptly.
doctor_discussion_points: List all medicines, supplements, and recent medication changes and when the rash began.
